name: predict_failure
description: ML-based failure prediction for equipment: remaining useful life (RUL) in days, failure probability, predicted failure mode and component, confidence interval, degradation trend, and recommended action.

name: analyze_vibration
description: FFT vibration spectrum analysis: bearing defect frequencies (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF), frequency peaks with diagnoses (imbalance, misalignment, race defects), and ISO 10816 severity zone classification (A-D).

name: detect_anomalies
description: Detect anomalies in recent multi-sensor data using z-score, moving average deviation, and isolation forest methods. Returns anomalies with severity, cross-sensor correlation patterns, and possible causes.

hours.description: Number of hours of recent data to analyze (1-168) (Default: 24)

name: get_reliability_metrics
description: Get equipment reliability and performance metrics: MTBF, MTTR, availability, OEE breakdown (availability x performance x quality), failure history, trends, and industry benchmarks.
